lean_basis: League of Women Voters state chapter that calls itself 'a nonpartisan, grassroots civic organization' (https://www.lwvtexas.org/about). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

lean_basis: Official state party organization.

name: Texas Democratic Party
lean_basis: Official state party organization.

name: Libertarian Party of Texas
lean_basis: Official state party; platform favors minimal government on both economic and personal issues.

name: Green Party of Texas
lean_basis: Official state party; platform centers ecology and social justice.

name: Texas AFL-CIO COPE
lean_basis: State labor federation whose site is headed 'Fighting for Texas Workers' (https://texasaflcio.org/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Texas State Teachers Association
lean_basis: NEA-affiliated teachers' union that says 'TSTA is a movement to change the way public schools, their students and employees are treated' (https://tsta.org/about-tsta/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Texas Association of Business (TXBIZ PAC)
lean_basis: State chamber of commerce that says it advances 'policies that support a competitive, free market business climate' (https://www.txbiz.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Texans for Lawsuit Reform PAC
lean_basis: Tort-reform group backed by businesses and professions whose stated mission is 'to foster freedom, innovation and job creation by advocating for a fair, efficient and predictable civil justice system' (https://www.tortreform.com/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Texas Farm Bureau AGFUND
lean_basis: PAC of Texas Farm Bureau, a farm lobby that says 'We believe private property rights are worth protecting, water should be used wisely and government should be responsive and responsible' (https://texasfarmbureau.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Texas Parent PAC
lean_basis: Public-education PAC whose guiding principles include opposing 'taxpayer financing of private school vouchers' (https://txparentpac.com/guiding-principles/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: NRA Political Victory Fund
lean_basis: Gun-rights PAC of the National Rifle Association, which calls itself 'a single issue organization' that grades candidates on 'Second Amendment issues' (https://www.nrapvf.org/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Texas State Rifle Association PAC
lean_basis: Gun-rights PAC of the Texas State Rifle Association that works to 'preserve the rights of law-abiding Texans' (https://www.tsra.com/tsrapac/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Texas Right to Life PAC
lean_basis: Anti-abortion group that says 'We’re Pro-Life Christians Saving Babies From Abortion' (https://texasrighttolife.com/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Planned Parenthood Texas Votes
lean_basis: Abortion-rights political arm of Planned Parenthood in Texas. Planned Parenthood Action Fund says the federation works to 'defend reproductive rights' (https://www.plannedparenthoodaction.org/about-us). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Equality Texas Action
lean_basis: LGBTQIA+ rights group that calls itself 'the leading statewide nonprofit fighting for LGBTQIA+ rights in Texas' (https://equalitytexas.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Texas Values Action
lean_basis: Social-conservative group that says it 'directly advocates for faith, family, and freedom in the political arena' (https://txvaluesaction.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Combined Law Enforcement Associations of Texas (CLEAT PAC)
lean_basis: Police union that says 'When our members need representation, CLEAT answers' (https://www.cleat.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Sierra Club Lone Star Chapter (Sierra Club Political Committee of Texas)
lean_basis: AllSides rates the national Sierra Club Lean Left (think tank/policy group; independent review, low or initial confidence, as of Oct. 2026). This is its Texas (Lone Star) chapter. Rating source: https://www.allsides.com/news-source/sierra-club-media-bias.

name: Texas Freedom Network / Texas Rising Action
lean_basis: Its stated mission or political identity includes: "mobilizing Texans for progressive change at the Capitol and in local municipalities". Source: https://tfn.org/about/.
